# Big McIntosh (Big Mac)

The strong, soft-spoken older brother of Applejack and Apple Bloom, Big Mac is a recurring Earth pony in G4's *Friendship Is Magic*. He works at Sweet Apple Acres with his family, and his quiet demeanor conceals a sensitive, thoughtful personality. He also appears as **Orchard Blossom**, a fictional female cousin he impersonates to enter the Sisterhooves Social, and **Sir McBiggun**, his unicorn knight persona in the Ogres & Oubliettes role-playing game.

[![Big Mac and Sugar Belle — Hasbro/DHX Media, The Big Mac Question](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/2021/4/20/2356238/medium.png)](https://twibooru.org/2356238)

- **Appearance:** Broad red stallion, golden-orange mane and short tail, green eyes, pale freckles and hooves, brown work yoke, and a sliced green apple cutie mark. [Color and design reference](https://mlpvector.club/cg/pony/v/35-Big-McIntosh).
- **Naming:** Originally conceived as Big Apple, according to [Lauren Faust's reported development recollections](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2013/03/random-mlp-facts-from-lauren-faust.html). Early merchandise used Macintosh; McIntosh, after the apple variety, became the established spelling in later merchandise, including the [2012 Apple Family set](https://www.strawberryreef.com/Index/Name/bigmacintoshFIMmini.html). Big Mac is his canonical nickname, not a fan name.
- **Speaking:** A speaking character, usually answering with “Eeyup” or “Nnope,” but capable of extended dialogue and singing. His English voice actor is [Peter New](https://www.actorpeternew.com/about), who also voices the Orchard Blossom disguise.
- **Appearances:** Debuts in Friendship Is Magic, Part 1 (S1E1); first speaks in Applebuck Season (S1E4). He sings with the Pony Tones in Filli Vanilli (S4E14), plays tabletop games with Spike and Discord in Dungeons & Discords (S6E17), and marries Sugar Belle in season nine. Their son appears in the finale, The Last Problem (S9E26). He also stars in [IDW's comic #9](https://www.equestriadaily.com/2013/07/mlp-comic-9-preview-on-itunes.html); his separate [Equestria Girls human counterpart](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Big_McIntosh_(EG)) appears in the 2013 film and Rainbow Rocks.

[![Sir McBiggun fan artwork by ilynalta](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/2020/7/17/966066/medium.png)](https://twibooru.org/966066)

## Important moments

- **Wanting to be Apple Bloom's hero again** — [Brotherhooves Social (S5E17)](https://tubitv.com/tv-shows/200165245/s05-e17-brotherhooves-social). After his disguise and overzealous competition go wrong, he admits to his sister that he misses being someone she looks up to, and they reconcile.
- **The surprisingly talkative teenage Big Mac** — [Where the Apple Lies (S6E23)](https://tubitv.com/tv-shows/200165217/s06-e23-where-the-apple-lies). The flashback reveals that he once talked at length and learns the value of listening during Applejack's escalating deception.
- **Love through listening** — [Hard to Say Anything (S7E8)](https://tubitv.com/tv-shows/200165205/s07-e08-hard-to-say-anything). Rather than competing with Feather Bangs through flashy romantic gestures, he builds Sugar Belle a display shelf for her bakery, showing that he understands what matters to her.
- **A proposal beneath his parents' trees** — [The Big Mac Question (S9E23)](https://tubitv.com/tv-shows/200165145/s09-e23-the-big-mac-question). After both elaborate proposals fail, he and Sugar Belle choose a sincere private proposal beneath Bright Mac and Pear Butter's intertwined trees and marry.
